title: Later tours with Snub Mosley: England, Pearl Harbor, Korea, the Downbeat
summary: Muddled dating of Holland clubs, England in 1952, Pearl Harbor and the Philippines in 1953, Pusan in November 1952, and a Chicago Downbeat stand in the early fifties.
